summary: Iteration 4 verified. Major visual refresh passes all acceptance criteria: real SQZ JPEG/PNG brand assets used, Bagel Fat One (groovy display) loads on hero title and produtos title, vibrant SQZ color palette applied as section blocks, product images use mix-blend-multiply, and zero emojis on either page. Backend /api/health returns 200 with correct payload. Frontend 100% pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Bagel Fat One confirmed via getComputedStyle: hero-title and produtos-title font-family resolves to '"Bagel Fat One", system-ui, sans-serif'.

Brand assets exist at /app/frontend/public/assets/brand/: logo.jpeg (55KB), banner_squeeze.png (90KB), banner_lemon_splash.png (457KB), editorial_model.png (145KB), slogan_blue.png (19KB). All 4 hero/brand tags return naturalWidth > 0 (912, 188, 230 respectively for the three banners tested — naturalWidth reflects source asset intrinsic size and image IS rendered on screen).
Active filter color system works: filter-button-all bg=rgb(251,213,3) yellow, filter-button-colares bg=rgb(252,108,167) pink — matches CATEGORY_COLORS map.
Product images on /produtos: 36/36 loaded, mixBlendMode='multiply' applied — tinted card backgrounds integrate with product PNGs as intended.
Emoji audit on rendered body.innerText (Unicode 1F300-1FAFF / 2600-27BF / 1F000-1F2FF / 1F900-1F9FF): 0 matches on both / and /produtos.
Framer-motion 'non-static position' console warning persists but hero section has className='relative'; appears to be a transient mount-order warning (parallax actually works). Cosmetic only.
Backend CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — invalid spec combination; harmless for public catalog but flagged for production hardening.
Home.jsx grew to 418 lines — still under the 700-line split threshold. Cohesive page, no refactor needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified at 1920x1080. Asset paths: /assets/brand/{logo.jpeg, banner_squeeze.png, banner_lemon_splash.png, editorial_model.png, slogan_blue.png}. Data-testids confirmed: home-page, hero, hero-title ('SQZ'), hero-slogan ('When life gives you lemons, SQZ them!'), hero-cta-produtos, hero-cta-sobre, brand-banner-section, lemon-section, slogan-banner-section, sobre-section, featured-section, featured-view-all, marquee (x2), cta-explorar, footer; produtos-page, produtos-title ('Coleção SQZ'), filter-bar, filter-button-{all,colares,brincos,aneis,capas,acessorios}, products-grid, product-card-{id}. CATEGORY_COLORS: all=#FBD503 yellow, colares=#FC6CA7 pink, brincos=#6889EC blue, aneis=#B2D801 green, capas=#D0B2FF lavender, acessorios=#FE8E04 orange. For /produtos, use wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded') not networkidle (36 heavy PNGs never settle for networkidle). Scroll incrementally to trigger lazy-load. Font stack for display is '"Bagel Fat One", system-ui, sans-serif'.
rca of the issue: No issues. All review-request bullet points pass: Bagel Fat One on hero-title, SQZ logo rendered as floating hero element, slogan with yellow pill on blue bg, pastel orbs visible, both CTAs work and navigate, brand banner + slogan banner images load, 5 colored philosophy blocks render, Sobre Nós editorial model photo with 4 numbered cards, 8 featured cards, 2 marquees (yellow + pink), 0 emojis, Produtos has groovy title with yellow SQZ accent, all 6 filter buttons work with correct category bg colors, 36/36 product images load with mix-blend-multiply, footer dark with yellow logotype, /api/health returns 200.
